display.name: EUDI PID
display.description: A demo Person Identification Data (PID) credential for testing PID verification flows. Its attributes follow the EUDI PID Rulebook v1.7 (the country-independent EU dataset), populated with the rulebook's own Jan Wijnand sample identity. Created by eudi-dev, not a real identity. Rulebook: https://github.com/eu-digital-identity-wallet/eudi-doc-attestation-rulebooks-catalog/blob/main/rulebooks/pid/pid-rulebook.md
